name: ca.buytravelinsurance/travel-quotes
title: Buy Travel Insurance Canada
description: Live Canadian Super Visa, Visitors, Snowbird & Student travel medical quotes (FSRA #24229985).

tools.name: get_travel_quotes
tools.description: Calculate real-time Canadian travel medical insurance quotes across regulated underwriters for Super Visa, Visitors to Canada, Canadians Travelling Abroad (snowbirds), and International Students. Returns CAD totals, monthly payment options, stability periods, pre-filled comparison links, signed instant-buy links, and FSRA #24229985 disclosure.

traveler_age.description: Primary traveler age in years (0 to 99).

program.description: Insurance program. Defaults to 'super_visa' when trip_days is 365, otherwise 'visitors'.

trip_days.description: Coverage duration in days (default 365 for Super Visa/Student, 30 for Visitors, 15 for Abroad).

coverage_amount.description: Emergency medical coverage limit in CAD (default 100000).

deductible.description: Per-claim deductible in CAD (default 0; common options 0, 500, 1000, 2500).

pre_existing.description: Whether stable pre-existing medical conditions are included (defaults to false if omitted).

couple_age.description: Optional spouse/partner age (0 to 99) for couple quoting.

couple_pre_existing.description: Optional separate pre-existing condition setting for the second traveler in a couple quote.

destination.description: Destination region for Canadians Travelling Abroad ('abroad' program).

trip_type.description: Trip structure for Canadians Travelling Abroad ('single' or 'multi').

monthly_only.description: Filter results to plans offering IRCC-compliant monthly installment billing.

limit.description: Maximum number of plans to return (default 8, max 15).

tools.name: get_plan_details
tools.description: Retrieve full emergency medical benefit schedules, pre-existing stability rules, waiting periods, exclusions, and IRCC visa-refusal refund terms for a specific carrier and plan.

carrier.description: Insurer or program name (e.g., Allianz, GMS, Manulife, RIMI, 21st Century, Travelance, TruStone, JF, MSH).

plan_name.description: Plan name or tier (e.g., Super Visa Essentials, Standard Plan 1, Enhanced Plan, Plan A).

traveler_age.description: Optional traveler age (0 to 99) to include contextual CAD pricing and buy link.

tools.name: get_buy_link
tools.description: Validate eligibility and generate a fresh 14-day Buy Travel Insurance Canada purchase redirect (/go) for instant online carriers or a pre-filled application deep link for advisor-assisted carriers, with medical assumptions and FSRA #24229985 disclosure.

carrier.description: Carrier name requested by the traveler (e.g., Allianz, GMS, Manulife, RIMI, 21st Century, JF, Travelance, MSH, DTGI, TruStone).

traveler_age.description: Primary traveler age in years (0 to 99).

plan_name.description: Optional specific plan name; selects lowest-cost matching eligible plan if omitted.
